messages:
mira: heads up — saw a spike in mTLS handshake failures in ap-south around 12:30 UTC, lots of traces with "cert not found" after recent rotator run. tagging sec.
sec-bot: ALERT: keystore.tombstone_rate > 4% in ap-south over 5m. Related runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/keystore-rotation (auto-detected)
ops_jun: quick log excerpt from edge-proxy (ap-south):
```
2026-03-21T12:34:11Z ERROR keystore: unwrap failed: AccessDeniedException: iam:Decrypt denied for key alias/service-keystore/2026
2026-03-21T12:34:11Z WARN  proxy: client cert lookup returned tombstone for id=ks-1972
```
samir: do we have DB markers showing tombstone=true? or is rotator leaving pointer to deleted keystore entries? any correlation with the RBAC PR we merged yesterday? @elaine can you check audit logs?
elaine: looking — I see keystore.delete events at 2026-03-21T12:30:02Z from rotator-v2, and later a bunch of keystore.read attempts that hit entries marked tombstone=true. Audit shows no KMS key policy change, but I *do* see a Deny for kms:Decrypt for service-account:deploy-bot around the same time.
mira: rotator reported success but may have left tombstone rows while KMS unwrap failed for the new key material. so proxies are referencing tombstone entries and failing mTLS.
samir: can we revert RBAC change quickly? which PR removed kms:Decrypt for deploy-bot?
ops_jun: PR 4621 tightened KMS permissions for deploy pipelines — merged ~2026-03-21T11:50 UTC. I think that removed keystore:unwrap capability for the rotator service account. link: https://git.redwood/pr/4621
mira: short-term mitigation idea: route affected region to the fallback cert-serving fleet (older instances with pinned keystores) while we fix tombstones. that will avoid user-facing TLS failures.
elaine: agree. also we should add an audit log trigger for any rotator-run that deletes keystores without successful unwrap. right now deletion and unwrap are not strongly correlated in logs.
oncall: assigning to @samir and @elaine. checklist: 1) request temporary KMS policy tweak to allow kms:Decrypt for rotator SA, 2) run rotator repair flow in dry-run, 3) re-run repair in ap-south, 4) shift traffic to fallback fleet during repair, 5) capture postmortem. please update status here.
keystore-bot: playbook recommendation: run db cleanup step `unstick-tombstones` then `rotator --repair --region ap-south --dry-run` followed by `--apply` once KMS policy in place. Command: `./rotator repair --region ap-south --confirm --audit=on`
samir: I'll open the KMS policy request now and include the deploy-bot as a temporary principal with strict scope and TTL. then run repair dry-run. ETA ~60m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
elaine: I'll create the audit alert for rotations that delete keys without unwrap success and add an entry to the rotation runbook to require unwrap verification step.
mira: thanks. after repair please paste the before/after failure rates (keystore.tombstone_rate) and any affected customer IDs. if SLOs were impacted we'll need an incident writeup.
ops_jun: spawning fallback route now (traffic-shift 25% -> fallback fleet) and monitoring. will escalate to 100% if errors persist.
samir: dry-run shows 0 unexpected deletions and reports 37 tombstones to be repaired. applying once KMS policy is approved.
oncall: noted. everyone, keep updates short. :thumbsup:
